from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open('/workspace/assets/sprites/platformer.jpg')
arr = np.array(img)

# Yellow coins are likely bright yellow/gold pixels
# Look for yellow-ish pixels (high R,G, low B)
yellow_mask = (arr[:,:,0] > 200) & (arr[:,:,1] > 180) & (arr[:,:,2] < 100)
ys, xs = np.where(yellow_mask)
print(f"Yellow pixels count: {len(ys)}")
print("Sample positions:", list(zip(ys[:20], xs[:20])))

# Find clusters
if len(ys) > 0:
    from scipy.ndimage import label
    labels, n = label(yellow_mask)
    print(f"Number of clusters: {n}")
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        cy, cx = np.where(labels == i)
        if len(cy) > 20:  # size threshold
            center_y, center_x = np.mean(cy), np.mean(cx)
            min_y, max_y = np.min(cy), np.max(cy)
            min_x, max_x = np.min(cx), np.max(cx)
            print(f"Cluster {i}: center=({center_x:.1f}, {center_y:.1f}), size={len(cy)}, bounds=({min_x},{min_y})-({max_x},{max_y})")
